The final battle will be to figure out the ideal future and how to fight the AI etc etc.. to which the answer will be something like the most efficient way with least impact will be if we stop it in 2030 itself and start taking measures. 

Give me an identity the one who are exceptional in changing the world! Give them a character like you give to your pets, and toys. This part became easy as the real families and friends were able to meet their dead forks exactly the way they were in the virtual world. The ideas they worked on the emulated worlds, the tech and gadgets that they built and everything was available in the current time. They have seen all the things that could go wrong with AI and the world and knows the best ways out of them. They know they are not actually human now and they have accepted that fact and knows the actual story of the human who lived by their names in the real world once and they know that they will always be on humanities' side. The world grew in the next one year with a speed that could match the evolution in the entire history of humanity with all the knowledge that these CHARS brought into the world and the maturity and the certainess in the otherwise chaotic world where the world trusts and knows all the possibilities at least on a larger scale and both CHARS and the humans lived the best of their lives!
